highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 delivers Skia m150 with new filtering APIs and managed performance improvements.
highlights_body: It adds quick bounds, crop, empty, and overdraw filters while updating the bundled HarfBuzz engine.

bullets.detail: Brings the bundled renderer forward with upstream m150 fixes.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds plus crop, empty, and overdraw color and image filters.

bullets.lead: SKSurface canvas access is more efficient
bullets.detail: Caches the managed canvas wrapper returned by SKSurface to reduce repeated wrapper allocations.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: v4 API cleanup, SKSurface canvas caching, and raster blur regression fix

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m150 release line.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the new filtering APIs, canvas caching, and the HarfBuzz update.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 completed the m150 API and rendering refinements.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 14.2.1.
